summary: [Gmail] events: Push: users.watch -> Cloud Pub/Sub topic -> push subscription POSTs to HTTPS endpoint; payload is ONLY {emailAddress, historyId} — a hint, not the message. Watch is time-limited (~7 days; refresh/revoke via watch/stop). Poll: users.history.list from stored historyId watermark, then fetch each message as raw MIME. Push is best-effort (~1 notif/sec per mailbox, may drop) — correctness rests on scheduled bounded reconciliation from the stored cursor.
